limitations: Only the two declared settings and one retained input seed are Racket-evidenced.
The finite setting rival is not an exhaustive hypothesis class.
The production generator and canonical selected authority are unchanged.
This prototype is proposed and is not catalog-approved or runtime-integrated.

materialization.public_filename_policy: challenge-<sha256 visible demos plus query inputs>.json; independent of private setting, seed and query answers
materialization.public_write_order_policy: lexicographic visible-derived filename; independent of ALLOWED_SETTINGS order
materialization.scope: proposed task-local prototype; canonical production unchanged

parameter.input_constraint: all retained inputs are lawful production scenes on which the two settings produce different outputs
parameter.name: mirror_mode
parameter.selection: one deterministic SHA-256-derived value per episode seed
